links.comparator_used: Manual contouring by the same readers, without AI assistance (randomized double-crossover)
links.outcome: Contouring accuracy (DSC), contouring time, and inter-reader consistency (Fleiss' κ)
links.effect: Junior DSC 0.73 ± 0.16 to 0.86 ± 0.14; senior DSC 0.79 ± 0.13 to 0.84 ± 0.15; contouring time reduced by 55%; Fleiss' κ 0.69 ± 0.12 to 0.86 ± 0.12 (all p < 0.01)
links.quote: In the reader study, AI assistance increased mean DSC in juniors from 0.73 ± 0.16 to 0.86 ± 0.14 and in seniors from 0.79 ± 0.13 to 0.84 ± 0.15, reduced contouring time by 55%, and improved Fleiss' κ from 0.69 ± 0.12 to 0.86 ± 0.12 (all p < 0.01).

design_hint: AI-assisted contouring with clinician review vs manual contouring
